# Sun Valley Cleaners

> Professional house cleaning services in the Greater Phoenix Area (Maricopa County), Arizona. Sun Valley Cleaners provides residential and commercial cleaning with a 100% satisfaction guarantee, eco-friendly products, and competitive pricing.

## Services Offered

### Standard / House Cleaning
Regular maintenance cleaning including dusting, vacuuming, sweeping, mopping, kitchen and bathroom sanitization, and full surface wipe-downs. Available on weekly, biweekly, or monthly schedules.
- URL: https://www.sunvalleycleaners.com/services/house-cleaning

### Deep Cleaning
Thorough, meticulous cleaning that covers baseboards, inside appliances, hard-to-reach surfaces, grout scrubbing, and detailed finishes. Ideal for seasonal resets and move-ins.
- URL: https://www.sunvalleycleaners.com/services/deep-cleaning

### Move-in / Move-out Cleaning
Comprehensive cleaning for property transitions including interior appliances, cabinets, closets, fridge, freezer, and oven interiors. Prepares homes to be move-in ready.
- URL: https://www.sunvalleycleaners.com/services/move-cleaning

### Airbnb Cleaning
Quick-turn property cleaning with linen changes and guest-ready preparation. Same-day turnovers available. Designed to boost guest ratings and maintain property value.
- URL: https://www.sunvalleycleaners.com/services/airbnb-cleaning

### Residential Cleaning
Premium whole-home cleaning using eco-friendly products with meticulous attention to detail.

### Apartment Cleaning
Specialized cleaning for apartment units with the same thorough service at apartment scale.

### Commercial Cleaning
Professional cleaning for business and commercial spaces.

### Housekeeping Services
Regular maintenance service with flexible scheduling and dependable results.

### Post-Construction Cleaning
Debris and dust removal after construction to prepare spaces for move-in.

### Event Cleaning
Post-event cleaning services.

### Linen Service
Specialized linen handling for properties.

## Cleaning Checklist Comparison

Sun Valley Cleaners offers three service tiers. All tiers include kitchen cleaning (sweep/mop, dusting, sink/fixture/counter disinfection, appliance exteriors, cabinet exteriors, cobweb removal, light fixtures, range hood, stovetop, stainless steel polishing, trash removal), bathroom cleaning, bedroom cleaning, and common area cleaning.

- **Standard Clean:** Regular maintenance of all main living areas.
- **Deep Clean:** Adds baseboards, all doors/doorframes, pantry shelves, and wall spot cleaning.
- **Move In/Out:** Adds interior fridge/freezer, interior oven, interior cabinets/drawers, and pantry cleaning.

Full interactive checklist: https://www.sunvalleycleaners.com/cleaning-checklist

## About

At Sun Valley Cleaners, we are dedicated to delivering a sparkling clean home. Our mission is to provide best-in-class service at a competitive rate and ensure customer satisfaction every step of the way. We use eco-friendly and non-toxic products safe for families, pets, and the environment.

- URL: https://www.sunvalleycleaners.com/about

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is included in your house cleaning service?**
Dusting, vacuuming, mopping, bathroom and kitchen sanitization, and full surface wipe-downs in all main areas.

**How often should I schedule professional cleaning?**
Biweekly cleaning is recommended for most homes. Weekly is ideal for busy households or allergy-prone residents.

**Are eco-friendly products used?**
Yes, eco-friendly and non-toxic products are used for all homes to ensure safety for families, pets, and the environment.

**How do I schedule a cleaning?**
Use the online booking form at sunvalleycleaners.com/book-appointment or call (623) 295-0506.

**Can I customize the service?**
Yes, the detailed booking form allows customization with real-time pricing updates.

**What areas do you serve?**
Phoenix, Scottsdale, Paradise Valley, Tempe, Mesa, Queen Creek, Chandler, Gilbert, and Arcadia in the Greater Phoenix Area.
